title: agentgw policy file
description: The YAML policy grammar (parsed as JSON). Semantics, precedence and the Cedar each construct compiles to are in contracts/policy-yaml.md. Globs use `*` only. Amounts are decimal numbers in `currency` units, converted to micros with round-half-away-from-zero. Version 1 (rev 10, gap-008: approvers meaning; rev 4, agents minItems).

agents.description: Known agents. When non-empty, a principal whose agent_id is not listed is denied with rule_id 'unknown-agent'. Empty means any agent id is accepted.

id.description: Exact agent id, not a glob.

budgets.description: Spending limits, enforced by Budget.Reserve. Every item whose agent and tool globs match a call applies; the call must fit all of them.

limits.description: Windows to cap. An absent window is unlimited; 0 blocks all spend.

rules.description: Evaluated as a set: deny beats require_approval beats allow; ties go to file order; no match is deny.

id.description: Unique in the file. Becomes the Cedar policy id and the ledger rule_id. 'default-deny', 'unknown-agent' and 'evaluation-error' are reserved.

agents.description: Agent id globs, any may match. Omitted means every agent. An empty list is a compile error (fail closed; YAML cannot distinguish [] from omitted reliably).

when.description: All listed conditions must hold for the rule to match.

budget_remaining_below.description: budget_remaining[window] strictly less than this. A window absent from the input never satisfies this.

approvers.description: Only with effect require_approval. Each entry is the identity reported by the surface doing the approving (for GitHub comments the GitHub login, compared case-insensitively); no prefix syntax. An entry that is not a valid identity on a surface never matches there (an email never matches a GitHub login), so that surface fails closed and the call is decided from the terminal or expires. Omitted or empty means any approver who passes the surface's own checks. The terminal does not enforce the list (its identity is the approver-key holder). Rev 10, gap-008, docs/adr/0011 decision 8.

timeout.description: Only with effect require_approval. Go duration; default 10m.
